+from typing import Optional
+
+# Pre-compiled translation table for HTML escaping
+_HTML_ESCAPE_TABLE = str.maketrans({
+    "&": "&",
+    "<": "<",
+    ">": ">",
+    '"': """,
+    "'": "'",
+})
+
+
+def escape(text: str) -> str:
+    """Encode special characters in text for safe HTML rendering."""
+    return text.translate(_HTML_ESCAPE_TABLE)
+
+
+def page(title: str, body: str, css_link: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    """Produce a complete HTML5 document string with doctype, head, and main body."""
+    css_tag = f'    <link rel="stylesheet" href="{css_link}">\n' if css_link else ""
+    return (
+        "<!DOCTYPE html>\n"
+        "<html>\n"
+        "<head>\n"
+        f"    <meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n"
+        f"    <title>{title}</title>\n"
+        f"{css_tag}"
+        "</head>\n"
+        "<body>\n"
+        f"    <main>\n{body}\n    </main>\n"
+        "</body>\n"
+        "</html>"
+    )
